Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Tucson hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 8 of the 18 Tucson hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Agoda at 2, goseek.com at 1, groupon.com at 1 and the hotel's own site at 1. These are the Tucson rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 12 of the 17 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. At the other 5, no site was 5% or more below it. Taxes and fees at Tucson hotels

At the 16 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($15 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 12% at La Posada Lodge & Casitas, an Ascend Collection Hotel to 16% at TownePlace Suites by Marriott Tucson Airport. At 1 hotel no site reported a before-tax price, so its price is a listed price that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
